fields: h, cols, rows [{p, v, m, hl}], fold, fold_noun, note. Figures are read from the value text ("± n unit" or "a % to b %"); nothing is added.
best_for: ToleranceScales reads instrument calibration as acceptance bands: each instrument a row with its name and basis, and one readout per check with the acceptance set large and a ruler showing the nominal line and the band between the limits.

rows.p: UV lamp intensity [UV, standard or option]
rows.v: Against a reference sensor or the maker’s method

block.note: Certificates show as-found and as-left values. Calibrated by [calibration provider and accreditation held].
